_comment: Single source of truth for TTS voices. See docs/tts-format.md. Voice picks are PROVISIONAL: they use Gemini's prebuilt voice names and must be auditioned in Italian before the pilot audio run. Children are voiced by adult prebuilt voices with an age style; audition carefully. 'name' is how the character is shown in story.md and parallel.md. When a new minor character gets lines, add them here with a voice from unused_prebuilt_voices (and remove it from that list).

level_styles.A1: speaking slowly and very clearly, standard Italian pronunciation
level_styles.A2: speaking a little slower than normal, clearly

ben.name: Ben
ben.style: 41-year-old American man, upbeat and eager, noticeable American accent in Italian

chiara.name: Chiara
chiara.style: 40-year-old Italian woman from Milan, quick and decisive

leo.name: Leo
leo.style: 8-year-old boy, high and bright child's voice, curious

franco.name: Franco
franco.style: 71-year-old man, gravelly, gruff and slow, secretly warm

pietro.name: Pietro
pietro.style: 8-year-old boy, high child's voice, a confident little know-it-all
